1.question: Wie mache ich meine Marke viral?
1.answer: Wenn Sie eine Kampagne auf Clipshub starten, wird Ihr Angebot sofort für Tausende Creator sichtbar. Sie greifen Ihre Kampagne auf und promoten Ihre Marke, sodass Sie hunderte Millionen potenzieller Viewer erreichen. Sie zahlen nur für 100 % verifizierte Views und können die Funnel-Performance leicht nachverfolgen.

2.question: Welche Funnel ist für meine Kampagne am effektivsten?
2.answer: Die effektivsten Funnel fokussieren sich auf einen möglichst niedrigen CPA. Keine Sorge – Ihr persönlicher Account Manager auf unserer Plattform hat viel Erfahrung und führt Sie Schritt für Schritt zu den bestmöglichen Ergebnissen.

3.question: Wie lade ich Budget für meine Kampagne auf?
3.answer: Wir unterstützen derzeit Banküberweisung, PayPal, Kreditkarten, USDT (TRC20), USDT (ERC20) und Bitcoin (BTC).

4.question: Woher weiß ich, dass die Views echt sind?
4.answer: Unsere Plattform nutzt einen dreistufigen Verifizierungsprozess, bevor etwas berechnet wird. Ein Schritt ist automatisiert, zwei weitere werden manuell von unseren Moderatoren geprüft. Wir liefern Traffic und Content in Top-Qualität – Ihre Ergebnisse sind unsere Priorität und wir möchten Ihr langfristiger Growth-Partner sein.

5.question: Welcher CPM gilt auf Clipshub?
5.answer: Sie legen Ihren eigenen CPM fest – basierend auf Marktangebot und Nachfrage. Ihr Account Manager hilft Ihnen, die Kampagnen für maximale Performance auszusteuern.

6.question: Kann ich die Ergebnisse meiner Kampagne tracken?
6.answer: Natürlich! Sie verfolgen Besuche, Likes, Kommentare, Brand Mentions und Klicks auf Ihre Referral-Links, um Conversions zu überwachen und Erfolg zu messen.

7.question: Wie schnell kann ich meine Kampagne starten?
7.answer: Mit unserem Team kann Ihre Kampagne in weniger als einer Stunde live gehen. Der Prozess ist simpel, schnell und effizient gestaltet.

useOfCookies.title: USE OF COOKIES

Your browser then provides that unique identifier to use each time you submit a query to the Site. We use cookies on the Site to, among other things, keep track of services you have used, record registration information, record your user preferences, keep you logged into the Site, facilitate purchase procedures, detect and prevent fraud, make your online experience more efficient and enjoyable, and track the pages you visit. typesOfCookies.title: TYPES OF COOKIES

1.title: Strictly Necessary:
1.description: These Cookies are essential for you to be able to navigate the Website and use its features. Without these Cookies, the services you have asked for could not be provided.

2.title: Functionality:
2.description: These Cookies allow our Website to remember the choices you make (such as your user name, language, last action and search preferences) and provide enhanced, more personal features. The information collected by these Cookies is anonymous and cannot track your browsing activity on other websites.

3.title: Performance:
3.description: These Cookies collect information about how you use the Website, e.g. which pages you go to most often. These Cookies do not collect personally identifiable information about you. All information collected by these Cookies is aggregated and anonymous and is only used to improve how the Website works;

4.title: Targeting or Advertising:
4.description: These Cookies are used to deliver adverts more relevant to you and your interests. They are also used to limit the number of times you see an advertisement on our Website and help measure the effectiveness of the advertising campaign. They are usually placed by advertising networks with the website operator’s permission. They remember that you have visited a website and this information is shared with other organisations such as advertisers.

cookiesUsedByUs.title: COOKIES USED BY US

3.title: Our Cookies

These are necessary cookies, without which the Site won't work properly or be able to provide certain features and functionalities. Some of these may be manually disabled in your browser, but may affect the functionality of the Site.

5.title: Security Cookies

These cookies cannot be turned off individually, but you can disable all cookies in your browser.

7.title: Third-Party Cookies

We may use session, persistent, first- party and third-party cookies. Cookies, by themselves, do not tell us your e-mail address or other Personal Data unless you choose to provide this information to us. Once you choose to provide Personal Data, however, this information may be linked to the data stored in a cookie. You can set your browser to notify you when you receive a cookie, or change your preferences (here) providing you with as much control as you wish as to the decision to accept/reject the cookie, and deletion of the cookie upon leaving our Website. We use these tools for such purposes as compiling aggregate statistics about Website usage and response rates. A pixel tag is an electronic image (often a single pixel), that is ordinarily not visible to website visitors, and may be associated with cookies on visitors’ hard drives. Pixel tags allow us and our service providers to count users who have visited certain pages of the Website, to deliver customized services, and to help determine the eﬀectiveness of our Website and Services. When used in HTML-formatted email messages, pixel tags can inform the sender of the email whether and when the email has been opened. As you use the Internet, you leave a trail of electronic information at each website you visit. This information, which is sometimes referred to as “clickstream data” , can be collected and stored by a website's server. Clickstream data can reveal the type of computer and browsing software you use and the address of the website from which you linked to the Website. We may use clickstream data as a form of non-Personal Data to determine how much time visitors spend on each page of our Website, how visitors navigate through the Website, and how we may tailor our web pages to better meet the needs of visitors. otherTrackingTechnologies.description: In addition to cookies, we may use web beacons, pixel tags, and other tracking technologies on the Site to help customize the Site and improve your experience. They collect only a limited set of data, such as a cookie number, time and date of page or email view, and a description of the page or email on which they reside.
